acceptance: make agent-write-preflight reports an untracked, non-ignored file that appeared in the primary clone since the session snapshot, naming the path and the recovery.
Files present when the snapshot was taken and gitignored files do not trigger it.
A test covers a new untracked file (reported) and a pre-existing untracked file (silent).
docs/agent/primary-clone-guard.md and primary-clone-update.md describe the new coverage.
description: The primary-clone write guard has two layers: a pre-tool hook, and a per-session snapshot check in make agent-write-preflight that reports writes after the fact. The snapshot ignores untracked files (docs/agent/primary-clone-guard.md). On 2026-11-15 a live probe showed Codex 0.162.1 and 0.169.0 never call the PreToolUse hook for apply_patch (openai/codex#27833), and Gemini CLI cannot be run to prove its hook. So a new file such an agent creates in the primary clone is caught by neither layer; only edits to tracked files reach the backstop. Untracked files were excluded originally because the primary clone legitimately holds ignored and local files, so a naive inclusion would be noisy.
